findings.summary: Duplicate `jwt_audience` field in config.py. The second definition (Field('ai-service', ...)) silently overrides the first (Field(None, ...)), making audience validation non-optional and breaking deployments that intentionally omit SOS_JWT_AUDIENCE. The opt-out branch in _decode_token is unreachable.
findings.action: Remove the first (nullable) definition. Keep the second with default 'ai-service' and update docs, or keep the first with default None and remove the second — whichever matches deployment intent.

findings.summary: TriageService._handle_message() commits the inbox_event INSERT in Tx A, then calls triage_complaint() in Tx B. A crash between them permanently marks the event as processed while skipping the triage_suggestion write. Complaints processed during that window receive no AI classification.
findings.action: Inline the idempotency INSERT into the same transaction as the triage_suggestion upsert and domain event publish, after the LLM call (which must remain outside any transaction). Matches the pattern already used by knowledge and estate consumers.

findings.summary: _get_recent_history() uses Tenant.platform() which sets app.society_ids='{}'. RLS on conversation_message filters out all rows silently, causing every helpdesk response to be generated without conversation history.
findings.action: Replace Tenant.platform() with Tenant.system(society_id), passing the active society_id through from the chat() caller.
